_comment: cc-P219: SL_Mining.py, a short run: make a miner, stand at a mine spot, mine five times, see ore. Run it with D:\UO\golem\Test-LegionScript.ps1 -Script SL_Mining.py -Plan <this file>. The spot is Trammel 2553, 479 (z 8), beside the Minoc mine's rock at 2553, 478, where SL_Mining.log shows a dig at every swing on 2026-10-18. The overrides turn off the control window, wandering and forge trips, so the script starts mining at once and stays put.
setup: [global set Skills.Mining.Base 100 Str 100 where playermobile Name == "{player}"
[global set LogoutMap Trammel LogoutLocation "(2553, 479, 8)" where playermobile Name == "{player}"
failOn: (?i)Traceback|No pickaxe or shovel|Out of mining tools

steps.name: stands at the Minoc mine spot
mines five times
steps.pattern: (?i)you dig some|and put (it|them) in your backpack
